snippet.title: Become - Short Trailer
snippet.description:
Play as a tiny sperm in the microcosm of the human body.
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710850/Become/ 

Be the one to create new life.

Wiggle, dash, and outsmart millions of rivals.

Grow stronger, explore and survive the traps of the immune system in this whimsical and humorous single-player adventure.


Playtime: 2-3 hours linear experience 
Platforms: PC (Steam) 
Release: November 2026 
Developer & Publisher: Valentin Wirth 
UI and Programming: Marek Nesvadba 
Music by: Martin Srpek Konvička: https://play.reelcrafter.com/iqRAWsT7SAKIH2W8QTqg3Q

#BecomeGame #indiegame #indiedev #gametrailer #funnygaming
